extensions.notes: OpenVue is the supported successor; exact authoring snapshot is 1.0.0 with Vue 3.5.44, while Vuetify remains preferred at its authored 4.3.0 baseline. Eight capability references are backed by assets/openvue-coverage.json: all 122 pinned official documents retain native routing hypotheses and receive final semantic dispositions. Context7 is discovery, not release or runtime certification; reconcile installed exports and declarations and use only bounded executed evidence in assets/verification.json. Future-major compatibility is not assumed.
